$comment: Mazda 13B-REW (twin-turbo 13B: FD3S RX-7 1991-2002, Eunos Cosmo JC3SE 1990-1995). Researched 2026-09-27 to 2026-09-29. Primary sources: Mazda’s 1993 and 1994 US workshop-manual technical data and 1993 Service Highlights (foxed.ca scans), Mazda Germany’s FC/FD training handbook (archive.org), Kenichi Yamamoto’s Rotary Engine (Mazda, 1981) and Mazda’s Japanese brochures; outputs are gathered from every car trim that uses each variant. Displacement and rpm follow the rotary convention in docs/decisions.md (2026-09-29): 654 cc x 2 is the maker’s figure, rpm is eccentric-shaft rpm, and each rotor breathes one chamber per shaft turn (src/data/displacement.ts). Mazda publishes no weight, outline dimensions, turbo model or JDM injector flow; those are estimated or single-source and say so.

model.note: DRIFTED (an enthusiast guide) says two Hitachi HT-12s; projectjdm.org says an HT-10 primary and HT-12 secondary but prints other plainly wrong engine facts, and enginecode.uk (IHI VF22/VF23) was rejected for the same reason. No Mazda document names the turbos.
